# Leonida Tours: full site text for AI assistants

> Independent South Florida tour company running small-group and private tours to the real Miami, Everglades and Florida Keys places. Reservations need no prepayment. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any game publisher. All game names are used only to identify real-world locations.

Site: https://leonidatours.com/  |  Contact: https://leonidatours.com/contact/  |  One form for enquiries, and we answer by email. No street address, phone number or mailbox is published: pickup points are sent with each booking, and we collect guests across the greater Miami area.

## Real locations

Every stop on a Leonida Tours route is a real, publicly accessible place in South Florida. This is the field guide to the ones that map to locations in Grand Theft Auto VI, with addresses, coordinates and how confident we are about each match. We rate every identification so you know what is a documented landmark and what is community reconstruction.

### The Clevelander (Vice Beach)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/ocean-view-hotel-clevelander/
- Address: 1020 Ocean Drive, Miami Beach, FL 33139  |  Coordinates: 25.78104, -80.13046
- In the game as: Ocean View Hotel  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 (0:33) and Trailer 2 (2:34)
- The in-game Ocean View Hotel is the Clevelander, the pink-neon Art Deco hotel on Ocean Drive in South Beach. The facade, the corner sign and the pool-bar frontage in the trailer all match a building that has stood at 1020 Ocean Drive since 1938. It is a working hotel, a bar and a landmark most people walk past without knowing what it is.
- Q: Is the Ocean View Hotel in GTA 6 the Clevelander? A: Almost certainly. The Clevelander's pink Art Deco facade and rooftop neon sign appear in the trailer in the same position as the in-game hotel. It is the most widely repeated identification in the community, though no official list of real-world inspirations has ever been published.
- Q: Can you stay at the Clevelander? A: Yes. It operates as a hotel, a bar and an event venue. Rooms and the rooftop pool deck are for guests; the street outside is for everyone.
- Q: Is it on the tour? A: Yes. It is stop one on the Miami Vice City small-group tour and the first stop on both private routes.

### Calle Ocho and Máximo Gómez Park (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/calle-ocho-little-cuba/
- Address: SW 8th Street, Little Havana, Miami, FL 33135  |  Coordinates: 25.76704, -80.21702
- In the game as: Little Cuba  |  Confidence: Official naming
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:02) and the official Vice City region page
- Little Cuba is the real Little Havana. The official Vice City description names it directly: "the bustling panederias of Little Cuba," alongside Ocean Beach's pastel Art Deco hotels and the VC Port. The real district runs along Calle Ocho, SW 8th Street, and its centrepiece is Máximo Gómez Park, the small square of domino tables that the game turns into its main street.
- Q: Is Little Cuba in GTA 6 the same as Little Havana? A: Yes. The official Vice City page names "Little Cuba" as one of the city's neighbourhoods. Little Cuba is the nickname for the real Little Havana district, centred on SW 8th Street, so the game's district and the real one are the same place under two names.
- Q: What is Máximo Gómez Park? A: It is the small plaza at SW 8th Street and Miami Avenue that locals call Domino Park. The open-air domino games there have been running for decades, and they are the clearest real-world parallel to the game's Little Cuba street scenes.
- Q: Do you stop there on the tour? A: Yes, stop seven on the Miami Vice City small-group tour, with a cafecito and pastelito stop included.

### Wynwood Arts District (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/wynwood-arts-district/
- Address: NW 2nd Avenue, Wynwood, Miami, FL 33127  |  Coordinates: 25.8012, -80.1994
- In the game as: Stockyard  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:55) and Trailer 1 (0:50)
- The Stockyard is Wynwood. The trailer shows a street-car meet on a strip of murals and low warehouse blocks, and Wynwood is exactly that: a few dozen blocks of painted warehouses in Miami's Over-the-Riverfront neighbourhood where the street art is the point rather than a decoration. It is the densest concentration of large-format murals anywhere in the United States.
- Q: Is the Stockyard in GTA 6 Wynwood? A: Yes. The Stockyard is shown as a street-car-meet location lined with murals, and Wynwood is the real Miami neighbourhood with that exact combination: warehouse walls, big murals and night-time car meets. It is one of the most consistently identified locations in the game.
- Q: Do I need to pay to see the murals? A: No. The street art is on public walls and public roads. The Wynwood Walls and the adjacent garage are free to walk through; the galleries and shops around them are not.
- Q: How long do you spend there? A: About 25 minutes on foot, which is enough to reach the main mural blocks without turning the stop into a hike.

### Kaseya Center (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/sahara-arena-kaseya-center/
- Address: 601 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132  |  Coordinates: 25.78115, -80.18788
- In the game as: Sahara Arena  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:40)
- The in-game Sahara Arena is the Kaseya Center, the Miami Heat's basketball arena on Biscayne Boulevard in Downtown Miami. It is also the clearest example of how the game builds a location: the arena itself is only one part of the match, because the observation wheel to the north and the container cranes of PortMiami to the south are arranged in the game exactly as they are in the real city.
- Q: Is the Sahara Arena the Kaseya Center? A: Yes. The arena's position on Biscayne Boulevard, its shape and the placement of the observation wheel and port cranes behind it match the Kaseya Center in Downtown Miami. This one was reported by press coverage shortly after Trailer 2 and is not contested.
- Q: Can you go inside the Kaseya Center? A: Yes, for a game, a concert or a tour on event days. Tickets are sold by the arena. On a normal tour we drive past the plaza and stop for the photograph.
- Q: Is it on the boat route too? A: The boat passes the waterfront below the arena and PortMiami, which is where you get the cranes-and-arena angle from the water at golden hour.

### E11EVEN (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/nine-one-nine-e11even/
- Address: 29 NE 11th Street, Miami, FL 33132  |  Coordinates: 25.7838, -80.195
- In the game as: NINE1NINE  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:28)
- The 24-hour club in Trailer 2 is E11EVEN, at 29 NE 11th Street in Downtown Miami. The identification rests on the name: eleven written as 9-1-1-9, the same digits reordered, which is the kind of construction that does not happen by accident. The real club sits on a low-rise block two streets back from Biscayne Boulevard, and it is the in-game nightclub.
- Q: What is E11EVEN in GTA 6 called? A: In the game the club is NINE1NINE. The real club is E11EVEN, at 29 NE 11th Street in Downtown Miami. The name match works because eleven, spelled as digits, becomes 9-1-1-9.
- Q: Can you go in? A: E11EVEN is a working nightclub with its own schedule and entry arrangements. We do not sell club tickets or alcohol; check the venue's current listings and plan your own night around it.
- Q: How close is it to the tour route? A: It is inside the Downtown loop, a short walk from the Downtown and Biscayne Boulevard stop on the small-group tour and within the private convertible and Jeep routes.

### PortMiami (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/portmiami-port-vice-city/
- Address: 1100 NW 6th St, Miami, FL 33133  |  Coordinates: 25.77806, -80.1733
- In the game as: PortViceCity  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 (0:24) and Trailer 2 (2:27)
- The in-game PortViceCity is PortMiami, the container and cruise terminal on Dodge Island. The official Vice City description calls it "the cruise ship capital of the world," which is Miami's port, and the trailer's speedboat chase and the gantry cranes are the terminals you can still see from the causeway and from the water.
- Q: Is PortViceCity in GTA 6 PortMiami? A: Yes. The trailer's speedboat chase and the row of container gantry cranes match PortMiami on Dodge Island, and The official Vice City description refers to "the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world," which is Miami's port.
- Q: Can you go inside the port? A: Not as a visitor. It is a secured federal facility. The cruise terminal promenade and the public causeway viewpoints are open and are where you get the photographs.
- Q: Which tour sees the cranes best? A: The boat tour, from the water. On land you pass them quickly on the MacArthur Causeway between Downtown and Brickell.

### Miami International Airport (Greater Leonida)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/miami-international-airport/
- Address: 5000 NW 36th St, Miami, FL 33142  |  Coordinates: 25.7959, -80.287
- In the game as: Vice City International Airport  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 (0:11) and Trailer 2 (0:36)
- The in-game Vice City International Airport is Miami International Airport, MIA, at 5000 NW 36th Street. It sits on the flat western edge of the city in the game, exactly where MIA sits in Miami-Dade: a spread-out campus of runways, terminals and cargo aprons that the game reproduces closely because the approach pattern and the overhead sign are so recognisable.
- Q: Is Vice City International Airport Miami International Airport? A: Yes. The game's airport matches MIA in position on the flat western edge of the city, in runway layout and in the terminal-and-taxiway frontage shown in Trailer 2. It is not the Fort Lauderdale or Miami Beach heliport that the game also uses.
- Q: Is MIA in the city of Miami? A: No. Despite the name, Miami International Airport is in Miami-Dade County, about 20 miles northwest of Miami Beach and around 12 miles northwest of Downtown Miami.
- Q: Can I get a tour to the airport? A: Not as a scheduled stop. All our tours pick up in Miami Beach, Downtown or Brickell, and we are happy to advise on airport transfers.

### Seven Mile Bridge (Leonida Keys)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/seven-mile-bridge/
- Address: Overseas Highway, Marathon, FL 32952  |  Coordinates: 24.7016, -81.15969
- In the game as: Seven Mile Bridge  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (0:04) and the Launch Trailer (0:03)
- The game's Seven Mile Bridge is the real Seven Mile Bridge, part of the Overseas Highway at Marathon in the Middle Florida Keys. It is the single most photographed structure in the Keys, an old seven-mile section of concrete arches running parallel to a newer highway that took the traffic in 1982, and the game reproduces the arches rather than the modern span.
- Q: Is the Seven Mile Bridge in GTA 6 the real one? A: Yes. The game reproduces the older concrete arch span of the Seven Mile Bridge at Marathon, including the arches that have been a fishing walkway since the 1980s, rather than the newer four-lane bridge beside it.
- Q: How long is the drive from Miami? A: About three and a half hours each way on the Overseas Highway, which is why our Keys trip runs as a full day with a morning departure. The Seven Mile Bridge itself is about two hours from Miami Beach.
- Q: Can you swim at the bridge? A: Yes. The channel between the keys is open ocean and there is a local swimming tradition with a marked course and a spectator boat on race day. Ask locally about current conditions before you enter, and respect the marked channel.

### Everglades National Park (Grassrivers)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/everglades-national-park/
- Address: 40001 State Road 6, Homestead, FL 33034  |  Coordinates: 25.2866, -80.8986
- In the game as: Grassrivers  |  Confidence: Official region + community match
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 (0:20), Trailer 2 (2:18) and the official Grassrivers region page
- The state's wetland region was named Grassrivers, and its official description names the alligators and the mangroves. The real place is the Everglades: a 1.5-million-acre wetland that runs from Lake Okeechobee south to the Gulf, 40 miles from the neon strip where the rest of Leonida Tours runs.
- Q: Is Grassrivers in GTA 6 the Everglades? A: Yes. The official Grassrivers page describes gators, mangroves and a primordial wetland expanse, and the Everglades is the only wetland region of that scale and character in Florida. It is the most confident regional match in the game.
- Q: How far is the Everglades from Miami? A: About 45 miles, roughly an hour and a half of driving from Downtown Miami, depending on traffic. The park entrance is off the Tamiami Trail, and the drive itself is one of the best parts.
- Q: Will you actually see alligators? A: Your wildlife guide takes you to the places gators are most often seen, and on a good day you will see them. Sightings are never guaranteed, because they are wild animals in a huge place.

### Jade Ocean Condominium (Vice Beach)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/jade-ocean-sunny-isles/
- Address: 17121 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles Beach, FL 33160  |  Coordinates: 25.93434, -80.12102
- In the game as: The Jade Ocean tower  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (2:33)
- The tower Lucia steps off in Trailer 2 is Jade Ocean, a glass condominium at 17121 Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach. The game's version is moved roughly ten miles south, closer to the centre of Vice Beach, but the building's rooftop helipad, its rounded profile and its position on the barrier island all match.
- Q: What is the Jade Ocean in GTA 6? A: It is a beachfront condominium tower in Vice Beach, shown in Trailer 2 with a rooftop helipad. The real building it is modelled on is Jade Ocean at 17121 Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach, which the game has moved about ten miles south.
- Q: Can you go to the rooftop? A: No. It is a private residential building with a gated lobby and a residents-only pool deck. The beach opposite and the street view are public.
- Q: Is it on a Leonida Tours route? A: No. It is about 35 minutes north of our meeting point on Ocean Drive and we do not run a scheduled stop there.

### Star Island and the Flagler Memorial (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/star-island-flagler-memorial/
- Address: Star Island, Miami Beach, FL 33139  |  Coordinates: 25.77404, -80.14889
- In the game as: Star Island  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 (0:11) and Trailer 2 (2:19)
- The villas in Trailer 1, filmed from a jet ski across Biscayne Bay, are Star Island, the man-made island off the MacArthur Causeway. The giveaway in the frame is not the mansions but the white obelisk above the trees on the right: that is the Flagler Memorial on Monument Island, and it can be seen from across the bay. No canal view can produce that sightline.
- Q: Is Star Island in GTA 6 the real Star Island? A: Yes. The white obelisk above the trees in the trailer is the Flagler Memorial on Monument Island, which is visible from across Biscayne Bay only from the water east of Star Island. That sightline is what pins the frame to this location.
- Q: Can you visit Star Island? A: It is a private gated residential island. You cannot drive or walk onto it. The boat tour passes close by on the public channel.
- Q: What is Millionaire's Row? A: The string of private islands along the east side of Biscayne Bay: Star, Palm, Hibiscus, Sunset and the Venetian Islands, known for their waterfront mansions and deep-water docks.

### Bayside Marketplace (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/bayside-marketplace/
- Address: 401 N Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132  |  Coordinates: 25.7794, -80.186
- In the game as: The observation wheel  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:40)
- The giant observation wheel beside the arena in Trailer 2 is the one at Bayside Marketplace, 401 N Biscayne Boulevard in Downtown Miami. What makes the match solid is not the wheel itself, but the company it keeps: the arena to the south, the port cranes behind, and the I-395 ramps overhead, all in the same arrangement as the real city.
- Q: What is the observation wheel in GTA 6? A: It is the wheel at Bayside Marketplace in Downtown Miami. It appears in Trailer 2 alongside the arena and the port cranes, in the same relative positions as the real landmarks.
- Q: Can you ride the wheel? A: Yes, it is an operating attraction with ticketed gondolas. We do not include the ride in our tour price; we stop at the plaza for the photograph and the view.
- Q: Is it far from the tour route? A: No. It is a few minutes' walk from the arena, and both are inside the Downtown stop on the small-group tour.

### Little Haiti (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/little-haiti/
- Address: 500 NW 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33128  |  Coordinates: 25.8065, -80.217
- In the game as: Little Haiti  |  Confidence: Official naming
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 (1:02)
- Little Haiti is the real Little Haiti, the Caribbean neighbourhood north of Downtown Miami. It is named directly in Trailer 2, and it is the one in-game district on our route whose real-world name is completely unchanged, which makes it the easiest place in the game to stand in and confirm.
- Q: Is Little Haiti in GTA 6 the same as the real Little Haiti? A: Yes. Unlike most in-game names, this one was left unchanged, and Trailer 2 shows the district in Vice City. The real Little Haiti is the Caribbean neighbourhood north of Downtown Miami, centred on NW 2nd Avenue.
- Q: What is the most photographed spot there? A: The mural at NW 2nd Avenue and NW 21st Street, and the Caribbean cultural centre and plaza next to it, which is where the community's gatherings happen.
- Q: Do you stop there on the tour? A: Yes, stop six on the Miami Vice City small-group tour, including a cultural centre stop and a patty.

### Venetian Causeway (Vice City)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/venetian-causeway/
- Address: 1000 Venetian Causeway, Miami, FL 33132  |  Coordinates: 25.79003, -80.17821
- In the game as: The Vice Causeway toll plaza  |  Confidence: Strong
- Where it is seen: Trailer 2 and Trailer 1 causeway sequences
- The toll plaza on the causeway in the trailer is Miami's real Venetian Causeway toll plaza, on Biscayne Boulevard between Downtown Miami and Miami Beach. The match is unusually precise: four lanes under a tiled roof, arches on stuccoed piers, the same signage on the same side, and a bike lane where the game puts one.
- Q: Is the causeway toll plaza in GTA 6 the Venetian Causeway? A: Yes. The four-lane plaza under the tiled roof, the arches on the stuccoed piers and the lane signage all match the real Venetian Causeway toll plaza in Miami, and the community has published the exact coordinates.
- Q: How much is the toll? A: The real Venetian Causeway toll is around $3.25 with a SunPass transponder, and higher without one. It is a few dollars either way, and most rental cars include the transponder as a service.
- Q: Is it worth stopping on the causeway? A: It is the single best approach shot in Miami, and on the small-group tour it is a formal stop. On the private routes it is the golden-hour photo stop.

### The VICE sign (Greater Leonida)
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/locations/vice-city-sign/
- Address: West of Miami International Airport, near the NW 25th St runway approach, Miami, FL 33142  |  Coordinates: 25.7906, -80.2851
- In the game as: Vice City Sign  |  Confidence: Community identification
- Where it is seen: Trailer 1 and Trailer 2
- Every open-world game needs one sign that says the place name, and GTA VI has the VICE sign: the tall illuminated letters on a metal frame beside the airport. It has been shown in official material, and mapping projects place it on the western edge of the city near the airport's runway approach, where a driver would pass it on the way in.
- Q: Where is the real VICE sign? A: Nobody knows for certain. It is shown in official footage near the airport, and mapping projects place it on the western edge of the city near the airport's runway approach, but no official real-world address has been published. We treat it as a community identification, not a confirmed match.
- Q: Why is this less certain than the other entries? A: Because there is a single object with no building behind it to match against. The other landmarks on this page are confirmed by architecture, position and surrounding context; a roadside sign has only its shape and its position to go on.
- Q: What is the closest confirmed match? A: The Clevelander on Ocean Drive, which carries the neon identity of Vice Beach, and the real signage on Ocean Drive itself.

## Blog articles

### GTA 6 Release Date: November 19, 2026 and What to Do in Miami
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/blog/gta-6-release-date/  |  Published: 2026-10-20  |  Category: Release
- The date is locked: November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here is the confirmed timeline, what changed twice on the way, and the smartest way to spend launch week if you are already in South Florida.
Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. That date is confirmed by the publisher, and it has survived two delays. It is also, almost exactly, the date our first tours begin running: we open on the same weekend, because the single best thing a visitor to South Florida can do that week is see the city the game is built from.

## The confirmed release date
The publisher's own site lists the release date and the platforms, and its parent company has confirmed it in its financial communications. There is no PC version listed on any official publisher, PlayStation or Microsoft page as of writing. If you are planning to play on PC, plan around that gap rather than assuming a later date.
| Platform | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| PlayStation 5 | Confirmed | Pre-order open |
| Xbox Series X|S | Confirmed | Pre-order open |
| PC / Windows | Not announced | No official date on any publisher page |

## How the date moved, and why that matters
The release date has been pushed twice, and both moves were announced with an unusual public apology. The pattern matters if you are trying to judge whether November 19 is safe: the publisher moved it once to a date it then moved again, and both announcements were framed around finishing the game to a standard rather than around any production problem.
| Announced | Date at the time | Change |
|---|---|---|
| December 2023 | 2025 | First public date, revealed with Trailer 1 |
| May 2, 2025 | May 26, 2026 | Pushed forward roughly seven months |
| November 6, 2025 | November 19, 2026 | Pushed back roughly six months, to a Friday |
The final date is a Friday. That is deliberate: Friday release dates let the first weekend be a full three days of play, and let the game's opening weekend be the first one that counts for review aggregators and for people deciding what to buy.

## What time does it unlock
No per-timezone unlock schedule has been published for launch, so treat any precise hour as speculation rather than fact. Historically, releases have unlocked at midnight Eastern Time, which is 9pm Pacific on the previous evening. If you are planning a watch party on the West Coast, plan for the evening of November 18, not the night of the 19th.

## Pre-order editions
Pre-orders are open for the standard edition, the Ultimate Edition, and a bundle with the Vintage Vice City pack. The exact contents of each edition are on the official store pages and change more often than you would expect, so check there rather than trusting a wiki summary. Whichever you pick, the game itself is the same game.

## What to do in Miami at launch
If you are in South Florida for launch week, you are in the best possible place, because you are standing in the city the game is modelled on. The neon strip, the causeway, the murals, the bay and the swamp are all within an hour of each other, and they are all still there in November.
Book the sunset departure, not the daytime one. The game's identity is the neon, and the neon only runs for about forty minutes after sunset.
Get on the water once. The trailer's establishing shot of Vice City is a jet ski on Biscayne Bay, and the real version is a two-hour loop past PortMiami, Fisher Island and Millionaire's Row.
Go west, out of the city, for half a day. Grassrivers is the Everglades, and the contrast between the swamp and the strip is the whole point of the game.
Do the Keys if you have the day. The Leonida Keys are the Florida Keys, and the Seven Mile Bridge is exactly where the game puts it.
> Our tours launch the same week: Leonida Tours begins running on November 19, 2026. You can reserve now with no prepayment needed: we confirm your date by email before public booking opens, with 20% off your first tour.

## What has not been announced
Quite a lot, and the gaps are worth knowing about if you are reading fan wikis. There is no published PC release, no published install size, no performance targets, no published map of any region, and no official list of real-world inspirations. Any page claiming the publisher has confirmed that a specific building is a specific in-game location is overstating what has been published.
What has been published is the official region copy for the six areas of Leonida, and that copy is the highest-quality primary source available. We quote it directly wherever it matters, and we separate it clearly from the community's location matching.
- Q: What is the GTA 6 release date? A: November 19, 2026, confirmed by the publisher, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no announced PC version. The date was announced on November 6, 2025, after two previous delays.
- Q: Is GTA 6 coming to PC? A: No PC version has been announced. There is no PC release date on any official publisher, PlayStation or Microsoft page as of writing. Announcements have historically come late, so check the official store pages rather than assuming.
- Q: What time does GTA 6 release on November 19? A: No per-timezone unlock schedule has been published. Releases have historically unlocked at midnight Eastern Time, which would be 9pm Pacific on November 18. Treat any specific hour as provisional until the publisher confirms it.
- Q: Are Leonida Tours tours running on release day? A: Yes. We launch on November 19, 2026, and run the Miami Vice City small-group tour daily, with a sunset and night departure at 6:30pm.
- Q: What editions are available to pre-order? A: The standard edition, the Ultimate Edition, and a bundle with the Vintage Vice City pack are all open for pre-order. Contents and pricing are on the official store pages and change, so check there before buying.

### GTA 6 Locations in Real Life: 24 Miami and Florida Places
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/blog/gta-6-locations-in-real-life/  |  Published: 2026-10-19  |  Category: Locations
- Twenty-four places, from the Ocean View Hotel to the Everglades airboat, each matched to a real address with coordinates and a confidence rating. This is the list to take with you.
No official list of the real places behind GTA VI has ever been published, and none ever will be: the studio does not annotate its own work. Everything below comes from trailer frames, from the official region descriptions on the publisher's own site, and from the mapping community's frame-by-frame analysis. We label how confident each match is, because a list that treats all twenty-four as equal is worth much less than one that does not.

## The 24 places, at a glance
| In the game | The real place | Where | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ocean View Hotel | The Clevelander | 1020 Ocean Dr, Miami Beach | Strong |
| Little Cuba / Little Havana | Calle Ocho, Domino Park | SW 8th St, Miami | Official naming |
| Stockyard | Wynwood Arts District | NW 2nd Ave, Miami | Strong |
| Sahara Arena | Kaseya Center | 601 Biscayne Blvd, Miami | Strong |
| NINE1NINE | E11EVEN | 29 NE 11th St, Miami | Strong |
| PortViceCity | PortMiami | Dodge Island, Miami | Strong |
| Vice City International Airport | Miami International Airport | 5000 NW 36th St, Miami | Strong |

| Star Island | Star Island, Biscayne Bay | Off the MacArthur Cswy | Strong |
| The Jade Ocean tower | Jade Ocean | 17121 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles | Strong |
| The causeway toll plaza | Venetian Causeway | 1000 Venetian Cswy, Miami | Strong |
| Little Haiti | Little Haiti | NW 2nd Ave, Miami | Official naming |
| Seven Mile Bridge | Seven Mile Bridge | Overseas Hwy, Marathon | Strong |
| Grassrivers | Everglades National Park | 40001 SR 6, Homestead | Official + match |

| Thrillbilly Mud Club | Redneck Mud Park | Charlotte County, FL | Community match |
| Vice City Sign | Unconfirmed | Near the airport | Community, weak |

## How to read the confidence column
Four labels, and the difference between them is the difference between a fact and an inference.
Official naming. The publisher uses the real place's name in the game or in its own official copy. Little Cuba and Little Haiti are the clearest cases: the in-game name is the real name, or the game's own regional description uses it.
Strong. At least three independent pieces of evidence agree: the architecture, the position on the map, and the surrounding context. The Clevelander, the Kaseya Center and the Seven Mile Bridge are all in this category.
Community match. One or two good pieces of evidence, generally a distinctive detail, with no official confirmation and no way to check. The Rusty Anchor and the Caribbean Club are good examples: the reasoning is sound but it is not proven.
Community, weak. A single object with nothing to match it against beyond shape and position. We include it because excluding it would look like we had cherry-picked, but we would not build a trip around it.
> The honest caveat: None of this is official. The publisher has never confirmed a single real-world location, and fan pages that present a complete location list as settled fact are reading too much into community consensus. Where we say "strong", we mean multiple independent lines of evidence agree, not that the studio confirmed it.

## The Miami cluster
Most of the identifiable places are in a tight cluster, and that is the single most useful fact for anyone visiting. The game's Vice City is built on real Miami geography: a barrier island across the bay from Downtown, a causeway between them, a port on an island of its own, and an arts district two miles north of the river.
That means the twelve Miami locations are not scattered across a map. You can see nearly all of them in a single afternoon, because the real distances are short: Ocean Drive to Brickell is about four miles, Brickell to Wynwood is two, and the port sits between them on the water.

## The wetland and the islands
Two of the largest matches sit outside the city. Grassrivers is the Everglades, a 1.5-million-acre wetland about 45 miles west of Downtown Miami, and the Leonida Keys are the Florida Keys, an 800-mile island chain starting 100 miles south. These are the two that make the game feel bigger than a city, and they are the two most worth a full day of your trip.
The real reason to care, though, is simpler. These are not obscure locations. They are some of the most visited places in the United States. The game's Everglades is the Everglades; the game's Seven Mile Bridge is the Seven Mile Bridge. You do not need a map of Leonida to find them, and you do not need to be a fan to appreciate them.

## How we verify a match
Our process is written down and identical for every location, because a site that tells you how it reaches its conclusions is worth more than one that simply states them.
Start with the official copy. The official Only in Leonida page gives a heading, a standfirst and a paragraph for each region. We quote it verbatim and treat it as the primary source.
Find the frame. A match has to appear in an official video, with a timestamp we can point at, so you can check it yourself.
Check the context, not just the object. The strongest matches are confirmed by the company the object keeps: the arena, the wheel and the cranes together; the obelisk visible from the water; the toll plaza's lane count.
Publish the coordinates. Every location we list has a latitude and longitude, so the claim is falsifiable rather than a vibe.
Say when we are unsure. Where the evidence is thin, we say so on the page, not in a footnote.

## Go and stand in them
A map is the limit of what a reference site can do for you. Every location on this list is a real, publicly accessible place, and most of them are within a short drive of each other. Our small-group tour covers nine of the Miami locations in a three-hour loop, the boat tour covers the port and Star Island from the water, and the Keys trip covers the Seven Mile Bridge.
> Independent and unofficial: Leonida Tours is an independent South Florida tour company. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, licensed or sponsored by any game publisher. All game titles, characters, place names and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used here only to identify the real-world locations that inspired them.
- Q: What real locations are in GTA 6? A: The most reliably identified are the Clevelander (Ocean View Hotel) on Ocean Drive, Calle Ocho in Little Havana (Little Cuba), Wynwood (the Stockyard), the Kaseya Center (Sahara Arena), E11EVEN (NINE1NINE), PortMiami (PortViceCity), Miami International Airport (Vice City International Airport), the Bayside Marketplace wheel, Star Island and the Flagler Memorial, the Jade Ocean tower, the Venetian Causeway toll plaza, Little Haiti, the Seven Mile Bridge and the Everglades (Grassrivers).
- Q: Has the publisher confirmed any GTA 6 locations? A: No. The publisher has never published a list of real-world inspirations and has not confirmed any individual building. Every match is either the community's reading of official footage or, in a few cases, a name the publisher itself uses in its own regional copy.
- Q: Where is the Ocean View Hotel in GTA 6 in real life? A: The Clevelander, at 1020 Ocean Drive, Miami Beach, Florida. Its pink Art Deco facade and rooftop neon sign are what the trailer shows behind the Vice Beach police stop.
- Q: Are the GTA 6 Everglades really the Everglades? A: Yes. The official Grassrivers description names gators and mangroves and calls the region a primordial wetland expanse, and the Everglades is the only wetland of that scale and character in Florida.
- Q: How many locations does GTA 6 have? A: Mapping projects have charted hundreds of named points across Leonida. The 24 on this page are the ones with enough independent evidence to stand behind, and we have deliberately left out the long tail of weak or single-frame guesses.

### Is GTA 6 Based on Miami? Leonida, Vice City and the Real Florida
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/blog/is-gta-6-set-in-miami/  |  Published: 2026-10-18  |  Category: Guide
- Partly. Vice City is Miami, but Leonida is a whole invented state, and the differences matter for anyone planning a trip or writing about the game.
The short answer is: GTA 6 is set in a fictional American state called Leonida, and its biggest city, Vice City, is Miami with the serial numbers filed off. The official copy for the city names the real neighbourhoods, so the answer is not ambiguous in the way that "it is based on Miami" usually is.

## What the publisher actually says
The official description of Vice City on the publisher's site reads: "We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderias of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world."
Four real Miami identifiers are in that paragraph. Ocean Beach is Miami Beach. Little Cuba is Little Havana. The VC Port is PortMiami. And "the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands" is a description of South Beach that you could write without ever having seen the game.

## Leonida is not Florida, and it is not Miami either
The distinction that trips up most articles is between the state and the city. Leonida is an invented state that borrows from all of Florida, not a renamed Miami-Dade County. Six regions have been published for it, and only one of them, Vice City, is the Miami analogue.
| Region | The real place behind it | Where it is |
|---|---|---|
| Vice City | Miami and Miami Beach | South-east Florida |
| Leonida Keys | The Florida Keys | Off the southern tip |
| Grassrivers | The Everglades | South-west Florida |
| Port Gellhorn | Panama City | Florida Panhandle |
| Ambrosia | Clewiston and the sugar belt | Lake Okeechobee |
| Mount Kalaga National Park | Providence Canyon State Park | South-west Georgia |
That is Florida plus north Georgia plus the compression of several hundred miles of real coastline into one fictional map. The keys are the keys. The swamp is the swamp. But the panhandle and the sugar country and the mountains are pulled in from three different real places and stacked on top of each other.

## The Miami details that give it away
The barrier island. The game puts a beach city across a bay from Downtown, connected by a causeway. Miami Beach is exactly that, and the game's ocean-side district is called Vice Beach rather than Little Havana.
The one-way street grid. Downtown Miami's signed one-way system survived into the game, which is a level of municipal detail most fictional cities do not carry.
The causeway toll plaza. Four lanes under a tiled roof, with the arches on the stuccoed piers and the signage on the same side as the real Venetian Causeway.
The tiki and pastel palette. The colour grading of the game's Vice City, saturated coral and teal against pastel pink, is the specific palette of Miami Beach's Art Deco hotels, not a generic 1980s Miami.
The port on its own island. Dodge Island, holding the container cranes and the cruise terminal, is an unusual enough real layout that the game reproducing it is a deliberate signal.

## What is Miami and what is not
Even inside Vice City, not everything is a one-to-one match, and pretending otherwise is how fan sites end up confidently wrong. The publisher reorders geography constantly. In the real city the airport is 20 miles west of Downtown; in the game it is close enough to see from the approach. In the real city the Jade Ocean is 10 miles north of Miami Beach; in the game it has moved south to sit inside Vice Beach.
The honest summary is that GTA 6's Vice City is a Miami you have already visited, compressed and re-lit, with a few deliberate rearrangements so that the game reads well rather than accurately.

## Coming to South Florida for the launch
If you are coming for launch week, the game is a better guide to this city than most travel guides, because it points at the parts that are visually distinctive and ignores the parts that are not. Ocean Drive, the causeway, Wynwood, Little Havana, the bay and the swamp: all of it is real, all of it is reachable, and all of it looks the way you have seen it.
> Trademark note: Grand Theft Auto, GTA, Vice City and Leonida are trademarks of the publisher's parent company and its affiliates. We use them here for identification and commentary, in line with our editorial policy. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any game publisher, and we use no game art, logos, characters or screenshots.
- Q: Is GTA 6 set in Miami? A: Vice City in GTA 6 is modelled on Miami, Florida, and The official description names real Miami neighbourhoods including Little Cuba, Ocean Beach and the VC Port. The game as a whole is set in Leonida, an invented state that also takes in the Florida Keys, the Everglades, the Panhandle, the sugar belt and part of Georgia.
- Q: Is Leonida just Florida with a different name? A: No. Leonida is a fictional state that borrows from several real places. It contains the Florida Keys and the Everglades as themselves, but also pulls in Panama City, Clewiston in the sugar belt and Providence Canyon in Georgia, and compresses them into one map.
- Q: Which GTA 6 city is Miami? A: Vice City, and specifically the Miami area: the game maps Downtown Miami, Miami Beach, Little Havana, Wynwood, Little Haiti, the port on Dodge Island and the airport to the west of the bay.
- Q: Does GTA 6 get the Miami neighbourhoods right? A: Mostly, with deliberate rearrangements. The barrier island, the one-way grid, the toll plaza and the port all match reality closely, while places like the Jade Ocean tower have been moved for dramatic effect.
- Q: Where is the nearest real thing to Vice City? A: Ocean Drive in South Beach. The game's Vice Beach is Miami Beach, and the pink neon hotel fronts are the real ones.

### GTA 6 Map: The Six Regions of Leonida and Where They Are
- URL: https://leonidatours.com/blog/gta-6-map-and-regions/  |  Published: 2026-10-17  |  Category: Locations
- Six official regions, one fictional state, and a surprising amount of real Florida underneath. Here is the official copy for each region next to the geography it borrows from.
Six regions have been published for Leonida, each with its own heading, standfirst and paragraph on the official Only in Leonida page. That copy is the best primary source available, and quoting it is more useful than paraphrasing it, because the copy is written as atmosphere while the geography underneath is quietly specific.

## The six regions, with the official copy
### Vice City
"Everything in Excess." "We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderias of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world."
The real place: Miami and Miami Beach, Florida. Why: the copy names Ocean Beach, Little Cuba and the VC Port, and the port is PortMiami on Dodge Island.
### Leonida Keys
"Gateway to Paradise." "The dress code is casual, the bars are loaded. Life in this tropical archipelago isn't flashy but it's easy. Get your buzz on and pull up a deck chair but look out, you are right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America."
The real place: the Florida Keys. Why: a tropical archipelago with a bar culture, on the edge of genuinely dangerous water, is a description of the Keys and only the Keys.
### Grassrivers
"Welcome to the Wetlands." "The untamable jewel of Leonida's crown. You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse. The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves."
The real place: the Everglades. Why: gators and mangroves and a primordial expanse, in a state that has exactly one of those.
### Port Gellhorn
"Live Hard." "This is Leonida's forgotten coast. Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won't bring the tourists back, but there's a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It's fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. Jump on a dirt bike and hold onto your wallet."
The real place: Panama City, Florida. Why: a once-popular Gulf resort town with closed attractions and empty strip malls is a precise description of Panama City's beach strip. The dirt bike and the stop-work economy are the game's addition.
### Ambrosia
"Keeping Leonida Sweet." "The battle for the health and wealth of Leonida begins here. In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme, whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, while the local biker gang provides almost everything else."
The real place: Clewiston and the U.S. Sugar mill on Lake Okeechobee. Why: a company town built around a single sugar refinery, on the shore of a big shallow lake, is exactly what Clewiston is. The refinery has been the town's reason to exist since the 1920s.
### Mount Kalaga National Park
"Wild, Wild Country." "Room to breathe on the state's northern fringes. A national landmark up against the state's northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government."
The real place: Providence Canyon State Park in south-west Georgia. Why: the canyon's eroded red clay walls are the visual match, and the park's remoteness matches the copy's geography. This is the one region where the prototype is outside Florida entirely.

## Reading the six together
The structure is consistent. Every region gets an economic base and a source of danger, and the copy is careful never to describe a mechanic. The publisher writes "offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails", which describes the park as a place; it does not announce a hunting system, and no official page describes how anything works.
| Region | Economic base | The danger | Real place |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vice City | Tourism and crime | The criminal economy | Miami |
| Leonida Keys | Bars and boats | The water | Florida Keys |
| Grassrivers | None given | The environment | Everglades |
| Port Gellhorn | A post-tourism economy | Cheap intoxicants | Panama City |
| Ambrosia | The Allied Crystal refinery | The biker gang | Clewiston |
| Mount Kalaga | None given | Hermits and radicals | Georgia |
That table is our editorial arrangement, not the publisher's taxonomy, and it is useful as a filter: any claim about a region's character that falls outside those lines is almost certainly inference rather than something the studio has written down.

## The county grid underneath
Beneath the six regions sits a second layer: a Florida-style county grid. Three county names have actually been seen on screen in official footage: Vice-Dale, on a police seal in the in-game Mega Noticias newscast in Trailer 2; Kelly County, read from roadside signage; and Leonard County, on a police vehicle in an in-game social media post. The remaining county names are community reconstruction.
The mapping community's reading lines Vice-Dade up with Miami-Dade, Leonard with Broward, Ambrosia with Hendry County, Kelly with a Collier and Panhandle blend, and Mariana with Monroe County, which covers the Keys and the Everglades together. It is a clean scheme, and it is inference rather than canon, but the three confirmed names all point the same way.

## How far apart are these places really
Leonida compresses hard. The Keys run more than a hundred miles from Key Largo to Key West, and Clewiston is about sixty miles inland from the Gulf. In the game, all of it sits inside one map, and a drive from Vice City to Mount Kalaga covers ground that would take four real hours.
If you are planning a trip based on the game's geography, this is the part that will trip you up. The game is one state. The real thing is a 400-mile diagonal across two states, and the Everglades alone is bigger than the game's Vice City region.

## Which of the six you can actually stand in
Vice City and Leonida Keys are the two you will want most, and both are within a short drive of Miami.
Grassrivers is a half-day from Downtown Miami and is the single easiest region to verify, because the Everglades is unmistakable from the first minute of an airboat ride.
Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga are all real, all visitable, and all a serious drive: Panama City is about eight hours from Miami, Clewiston about three, and Providence Canyon is further still.
- Q: How many regions are in GTA 6's Leonida? A: Six, according to the official Only in Leonida page: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- Q: What is Mount Kalaga National Park based on? A: The community match is Providence Canyon State Park in south-west Georgia, whose eroded clay canyon walls match the game's rock formations. It is the only region whose prototype is not in Florida.
- Q: What is Ambrosia in GTA 6 based on? A: Clewiston, Florida, on Lake Okeechobee, where the U.S. Sugar mill has been the town's economic centre since the 1920s. The Allied Crystal refinery is a renamed version of it.
- Q: Is Port Gellhorn Panama City? A: That is the strongest community identification: a once-popular Gulf resort town with shut-down attractions and empty strip malls matches Panama City's beach strip closely. It has not been officially confirmed.
- Q: How big is Leonida compared to Florida? A: Smaller in area but far more compressed in practice. The game's map holds the Keys, the Everglades, the Panhandle, the sugar belt and north Georgia, which in reality are spread across roughly 400 miles.

## How to use these timestamps
Two practical notes, because this is more useful than it first appears.
Watch for the context, not the object. The single most useful frame in Trailer 2 is the arena at 1:40, because it contains three separate real landmarks in one composition. When you match an object you get an opinion; when you match a set of objects you get a fix.
Traffic moves the same way. The game's one-way grid in Downtown Miami, the causeway approach and the US-1 strip all follow real street patterns. If you know what the real road does, you can often predict what the game is showing.
> Watching the trailers: All four are on the publisher's own site, and the YouTube uploads carry official subtitles. The Extended Look is age-restricted on YouTube, so watch it on the official site if you cannot sign in. We do not re-upload or mirror any footage.
